title: Gold fact: add `supply_mix` + `t` to fact_supply_share and migrate the global-only consumers
description: Union both silver supply tables into fact_supply_share with a supply_mix discriminator ('global' | 'eu_sourcing') and carry `t` through, per spec § Data Architecture → Gold Layer item 2. Then migrate every existing consumer that assumed the fact was global-only.
acceptanceCriteria: fact_supply_share grain is material × stage × country × year × supply_mix, with `supply_mix` and `t` present as spec'd.
Rows are unioned from silver_globalsupplyshares and silver_eusupplyshares with supply_mix stamped at read time; the two mixes are never summed together.
MIGRATION — v_supply_concentration_risk filters supply_mix = 'global', preserving its pre-DEC-001 meaning. Without this it silently double-counts once EU rows land.
The existing quality-scoring, unmapped-audit (gold_unmapped_supply_audit) and both v_fact_supply_share_* views work correctly across both mixes.
A row-count check confirms global-mix row counts are unchanged from before this task — the EU rows are additive, not a re-partition of existing data.
notes: CREATED 2026-07-29 by /breakdown task-038 (parent difficulty 7). Seams follow the parent's proposed breakdown, re-cut against the spec as amended 2026-07-29 (§ Business Logic & Calculations → Supply Risk, and § Data Architecture → fact_supply_share). Parent ACs were written 2026-07-19 and predate that amendment — the criteria below supersede them where they differ.

This is the change with the widest blast radius: fact_supply_share already has 3 views, an audit table and live DAX measures pointed at it. Criterion 3 is the one most likely to be missed and the one that silently corrupts existing numbers.
Spec anchor for the exact field contract: § Data Architecture → Gold Layer item 2 (fact_supply_share).

DEC-002 PARITY OBLIGATION: src/transformations is the reference implementation guarded by parity tests (tests/ loads the notebook's own functions via load_notebook_functions and pins them against the src/ version). Changing notebook logic without the mirror fails CI by design. The parent task's files_affected omitted src/ and tests/ entirely — that omission is corrected in these subtasks.

LOCAL TEST SETUP: build the SparkSession with .config('spark.sql.ansi.enabled','false') — local pyspark 4.0.1 defaults ANSI on, Fabric defaults it off, and cast semantics diverge in the dangerous direction (local raises where Fabric silently nulls). See root CLAUDE.md § Gotchas.
